objective: Make the Revision D mass model authoritative, hashed, traceable, and shared by every mechanical and release consumer.
acceptance: design-spec.json#components is the only current source of total mass and CG
every component has a stable ID, source, uncertainty, status, inclusion rule, units, and frame
the legacy 55 kg rows are preserved as superseded and excluded
duplicate, missing, invalid, stale, or disagreeing mass data fails closed
stop_conditions: owner approval or physical weighing would need to be fabricated
a change requires robot control, firmware, interfaces, or PCB ownership
the authoritative source and generated hash disagree
